In the past two decades, health workforce density (medical doctors, nursing and midwifery personnel, dentists and pharmacists) has increased by 52% globally, from 44.8 per 10 000 population in 2006 to 67.9 in 2025. There are now more than 70 million health and care workers worldwide.
